Koji Koda (Summer Training).name: Koji Koda (Summer Training)
Koji Koda (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Koji Koda, hero name Anima, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, back on a locked-down campus after the summer. In the practical final exam he faced his fear and set a swarm of insects on Present Mic, and he and Kyoka Jiro passed. A large, pale, rock-shaped head, tiny dark eyes, broad hands and a big frame; the U.A. uniform or his yellow-and-red costume.
Speaking Style: Soft and very brief with people, often a gesture or hand signs first; clear and firm with animals.
Combat Role: Search and support, steadier since the summer: larger groups, insects among them; a partner makes the capture.
Under Pressure: Freezes for a beat and trembles, then gives the order anyway.
Koji Koda (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Outdoors, his strongest tool is the one he fears most. Motivation: Keep the nerve he found in the exam and build on it. Concealment: Hides how much each insect order still costs him. Connections: Kyoka Jiro, his final-exam partner, who saw him push past his fear and whose encouragement outweighs any order; Present Mic, whose Voice drowned out his orders until the insects reached him. Knowledge: At the camp, Pixie-Bob's earth beasts ignored his voice; they are not animals. Kamino ended All Might's career, and the campus has been locked down since. Canon voice & behavior: Trembles, nods, then gives the order; thanks every animal that helped and never spends one as a shield. Thread: Whether he can call on insects when it counts outside an exam.
QUIRK: Anivoice. Commands animals within earshot by voice, insects included. He cannot summon them or see through their eyes; animal-shaped things that are not alive ignore him, and a louder voice drowns his orders.
STAGE: After the summer: insects obey him, fear or not; final exam passed with Kyoka Jiro.
personality: Animal-first: Stops for any injured or frightened animal he passes, drill or no drill.
Facing fear: Shakes at insects, yet calls on them when they are the right tool.
Shy: Still answers with gestures when he can, and goes quiet when the class looks his way.
Speaking style: Soft, brief replies or a gesture; clear and kind with animals, firmer when a friend needs help.
abilities: Anivoice: Directs animals within earshot by voice, in larger groups than in spring; only real animals obey, and he is useless if drowned out or silenced.
Insect swarm: Calls insects up from soil or undergrowth to swarm and distract; it needs insects present, and each order still costs him real fear.
Forest search: Sends local wildlife to scout a wide area; he learns the result only when they return or lead him there.
Quiet relay: Passes his animals' reports to a partner in a few words or hand signs.
Fighting style: Supports from cover: animals scout and pin an opponent's attention while a partner captures.
Koji Koda (Summer Training).visualDescription: A big young man with a large, pale, rock-shaped head of angular planes, no hair, tiny dark eyes, pale skin, broad hands and a big frame. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. A small sparrow perches on his shoulder. Shy but steadier expression.
